## Samsung and SK Hynix Rally After Temasek Investment Report Lifts Chip Stocks

Temasek's involvement — if confirmed as a direct position — adds sovereign validation to the HBM/memory cycle recovery thesis; both names are critical suppliers to the AI accelerator stack and their performance is a leading indicator for HBM pricing and DRAM cycle health.

- Samsung (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) shares rallied.
- A Temasek investment report was cited as the catalyst.
- Sovereign wealth interest adds institutional signal to the memory and HBM complex thesis.
- No specific investment size, stake percentage, or named holding cited in the headline.
